_comment: Alchemy Factory Dedicated Server via Wine + hidden Xvfb
name: Alchemy Factory (Wine)
author: admin@crackscout.eu
description: Alchemy Factory dedicated server (Windows exe) on Linux via Wine, hidden dummy X display, SteamCMD auto-update.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates lib32gcc-s1 tar
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/server
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz
cd /mnt/server
./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /mnt/server/server +login anonymous +app_update ${AF_APPID} validate +quit
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/steamclient.so 2>/dev/null
cp -v steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/steamclient.so 2>/dev/null
cat > /mnt/server/af-start.sh <<'AFSTART'
#!/bin/bash
cd /home/container || exit 1
SRV=/home/container/server
export WINEPREFIX=/home/container/.wine WINEARCH=win64 WINEDEBUG=${WINEDEBUG:-err+all,fixme-all}
export HOME=/home/container DISPLAY=:99 LANG=C.UTF-8
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/tmp/runtime-container; mkdir -p "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"; chmod 700 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"
unset WAYLAND_DISPLAY
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="
start_x() {
  if ! pgrep -x Xvfb >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    rm -f /tmp/.X99-lock
    Xvfb :99 -screen 0 640x480x16 -nolisten tcp >/home/container/xvfb.log 2>&1 &
    sleep 2
  fi
  pgrep -x Xvfb >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "[egg] Xvfb running" || { echo "[egg] Xvfb NOT running:"; cat /home/container/xvfb.log; }
}

if [ "${AF_AUTO_UPDATE}" = "1" ]; then
  echo "[egg] Checking for updates (app ${AF_APPID})..."
  if [ -x ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir "$SRV" +login anonymous +app_update ${AF_APPID} ${STEAM_BETA_ARGS} validate +quit \
      || echo "[egg] WARNING: steamcmd failed, starting installed version."
  else echo "[egg] steamcmd missing, skipping update."; fi
fi

start_x

if [ ! -f "$WINEPREFIX/.x11set" ]; then
  echo "[egg] Initialising Wine prefix (first start, ~1 min)"
  wineboot -u 2>&1 | tail -n 15; wineserver -w
  wine reg add 'HKCU\Software\Wine\Drivers' /v Graphics /d x11 /f 2>&1 | tail -n 3
  touch "$WINEPREFIX/.x11set"
fi

EXE="${SERVER_EXE}"
[ -n "$EXE" ] && [ "${EXE#/}" = "$EXE" ] && EXE="$SRV/$EXE"
[ -z "$EXE" ] && EXE=$(find "$SRV" -maxdepth 3 -iname '*server*.exe' ! -iname '*crash*' ! -iname 'UE*' | head -n1)
if [ -z "$EXE" ] || [ ! -f "$EXE" ]; then
  echo "[egg] ERROR: no server exe found. Set SERVER_EXE. Found:"; find "$SRV" -maxdepth 3 -iname '*.exe'; exit 1
fi
EXEDIR=$(dirname "$EXE")

cat > "$EXEDIR/ServerConfig.ini" <<INI
[ServerSettings]
server_name=${SERVER_NAME}
server_public=${SERVER_PUBLIC}
server_port=${SERVER_PORT}
query_port=$((SERVER_PORT+1))
server_relay=${SERVER_RELAY}
server_lan=0
server_password=${SERVER_PASSWORD}
admin_password=${ADMIN_PASSWORD}
max_clients=${MAX_CLIENTS}
max_admins=${MAX_ADMINS}
autosave_mode=${AUTOSAVE_MODE}
pause_when_empty=${PAUSE_WHEN_EMPTY}
session_retry_seconds=10
INI

cd "$EXEDIR"
echo "[egg] Starting $EXE ${EXTRA_ARGS}"
START_TS=$(date +%s)
wine "$EXE" ${EXTRA_ARGS} <&0 &
WPID=$!
trap 'kill -INT $WPID 2>/dev/null' INT TERM

# mirror newest game log into the console
( sleep 15; L=$(find "$SRV" -iname '*.log' -newermt "@$START_TS" 2>/dev/null | head -n1); [ -n "$L" ] && { echo "[egg] Following $L"; tail -n +1 -F "$L"; } ) &
TPID=$!

wait $WPID; CODE=$?
kill $TPID 2>/dev/null
echo "[egg] Server exited with code $CODE"
if [ $((`date +%s` - START_TS)) -lt 60 ]; then
  echo "[egg] Quick exit - diagnostics:"
  echo "--- xvfb.log"; tail -n 10 /home/container/xvfb.log
  for L in $(find "$SRV" -iname '*.log' -newermt "@$START_TS" 2>/dev/null | head -n3); do echo "--- $L"; tail -n 40 "$L"; done
fi
exit $CODE
AFSTART
cat > /mnt/server/af-wine.sh <<'AFWINE'
#!/bin/bash
# Manual: ./af-wine.sh server/<name>.exe [args]
export WINEPREFIX=/home/container/.wine WINEARCH=win64 WINEDEBUG=${WINEDEBUG:-err+all,fixme-all}
export HOME=/home/container DISPLAY=:99 LANG=C.UTF-8
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/tmp/runtime-container; mkdir -p "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"; chmod 700 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"
unset WAYLAND_DISPLAY
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="
start_x() {
  if ! pgrep -x Xvfb >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    rm -f /tmp/.X99-lock
    Xvfb :99 -screen 0 640x480x16 -nolisten tcp >/home/container/xvfb.log 2>&1 &
    sleep 2
  fi
  pgrep -x Xvfb >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "[egg] Xvfb running" || { echo "[egg] Xvfb NOT running:"; cat /home/container/xvfb.log; }
}
start_x
exec wine "$@"
AFWINE
chmod +x /mnt/server/af-start.sh /mnt/server/af-wine.sh
echo "-----> Install complete"

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: 1 = SteamCMD update check on every start.

variables.name: Steam Relay
variables.description: 0 = direct IP; 1 = join code only. (Join code works alaways no matter what.)

variables.name: Wine Debug
variables.description: Use -all to silence Wine. May result in zero outputs to console.
